sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: While underway, the crew on patrol sighted a perpetrator boarding the ship through the barb wire on the aft deck. The crew alerted the bridge and general alarm was raised. The perpetrator immediately jumped overboard and escaped in a boat, with another five perpetrators. A search was conducted, with no perpetrator found onboard. All crew members were safe and accounted for. Nothing was stolen.
